messages.subject: Very Bizarre unmarked Error
parts:
Hi all,

Happy Wednesday to you!

I was wondering if anyone has encountered this strange error when plotting N-mixture model functional relationships via predict()?
I have a dataset where the covariates are scaled within the model and, strangely, I can ONLY use predict() when my 'newdata' include at least SOME variation in the variable with a quadratic term.
So, for example, I built a model with "sapling^2 + forb + bare ground" in my lambda term. When I predict() using newdata that varies sapling, it works fine. However, if I hold sapling CONSTANT and try to vary, say, forb, I get this odd error:

Error: Matrices must have same number of rows in cbind2(.Call(dense_to_Csparse, x), y)

Has anyone encountered this?? Tips for defeating this beast? Thanks in advance for any tips! I searched the archives for this error and it appears two other times but the responses were not helpful in my case. Code pasted below.

Best,
D.J. McNeil

##################

setwd("...")
data1 <- read.csv("data_for_analysis.csv")

# Make an unmarked frame:
umf_hab <- unmarkedFramePCount(
  y = data1[,c('count_1','count_2')],
  siteCovs = data.frame("sapling" = data1$sapling, "bare" = data1$bare, "forb" = data1$forb),
  obsCovs = list(wind = data.frame("wind_1" = data1$wind_1, "wind_2" = data1$wind_2))
  )

summary(umf_hab)

##########################

unmarkedFrame Object

587 sites
Maximum number of observations per site: 2
Mean number of observations per site: 1.95
Sites with at least one detection: 441

Tabulation of y observations:
   0    1    2    3    4    5 <NA>
 452  336  267   80   11    1   27

Site-level covariates:
    sapling             bare             forb       
 Min.   :  0.000   Min.   : 0.000   Min.   :  0.00  
 1st Qu.:  4.773   1st Qu.: 0.000   1st Qu.: 37.00  
 Median : 20.000   Median : 0.000   Median : 54.00  
 Mean   : 30.773   Mean   : 8.208   Mean   : 54.56  
 3rd Qu.: 52.000   3rd Qu.:10.000   3rd Qu.: 71.00  
 Max.   :100.000   Max.   :96.430   Max.   :100.00  

Observation-level covariates:
      wind      
 Min.   :0.000  
 1st Qu.:1.000  
 Median :2.000  
 Mean   :1.714  
 3rd Qu.:3.000  
 Max.   :4.000  
 NA's   :27   
 
#########################

# top N-mixture model
lam.sapling.sq.forb.bare<-pcount(~ scale(dayz) + wind ~ scale(sapling) + I(scale(sapling)^2) + forb + bare,
                                 data=umf_hab, mixture="P", K=50)

# plotting functional relationship with sapling
newdat1 <- data.frame("sapling" = seq(from = 0, to = 100, length.out = 100),
                      "forb" = seq(from = mean(data1$forb), to = mean(data1$forb), length.out = 100),
                      "bare" = seq(from = mean(data1$bare), to = mean(data1$bare), length.out = 100))
pred1 <- predict(lam.sapling.sq.forb.bare, newdata = newdat1, type = "state")
plot(-1, -1, xlim = c(0,100), ylim = c(min(pred1$lower), max(pred1$upper)), ylab = "Abundance", xlab = "percent cover")
lines(newdat1$sapling, pred1$Predicted)
lines(newdat1$sapling, pred1$lower, lty = 2)
lines(newdat1$sapling, pred1$upper, lty = 2)

# This plot works just fine

# plotting functional relationship with forb
newdat1 <- data.frame("sapling" = seq(from = mean(data1$sapling), to = mean(data1$sapling), length.out = 100),
                      "forb" = seq(from = 0, to = 100, length.out = 100),
                      "bare" = seq(from = mean(data1$bare), to = mean(data1$bare), length.out = 100))
pred1 <- predict(lam.sapling.sq.forb.bare, newdata = newdat1, type = "state")

# Error: Matrices must have same number of rows in cbind2(.Call(dense_to_Csparse, x), y)
